a.lede: Ministers promise fresh procurement, but critics warn extension gives US supplier more time to dig in
a.title: MPs ask what the break clause was for as Palantir wins two more years in the NHS

b.lede: DHSC to extend US tech firm’s contract for two more years to allow time to line up British companies to replace it Ministers will end the NHS’s contract with the controversial tech firm Palantir – but not until 2029, to allow time to line up British companies to replace it. The Department of Health and Social Care (DHSC) has decided
b.title: Ministers to end Palantir’s contract with NHS in England in 2029
